items.stem: An auditor selects 25 items judgmentally from a population of 10,000 invoices. What is the key limitation?

options.text: Results cannot be statistically projected to the population
options.rationale: Correct: a judgmental sample does not support statistical projection.

options.text: The sample is too large to evaluate
options.rationale: 25 items is small, not too large.
No sample can guarantee the absence of errors.

options.text: It must always be 10% of the population

items.explanation: Correct: a judgmental sample does not support statistical projection.

items.stem: When should engagement objectives be finalized?

options.text: After a preliminary risk assessment of the area
options.rationale: Correct: objectives follow understanding the process and its risks.

options.text: Before learning anything about the process
options.rationale: Setting objectives before understanding risk is premature.

options.text: Only after the report is written
options.rationale: Objectives guide fieldwork and must precede reporting.
